snippet.title: Putin quer mais que a Ucrânia? - #shorts
snippet.description:
"A Rússia sabe exatamente o que quer. E a Rússia quer mais do que a Ucrânia", disse o chanceler federal alemão, Friedrich Merz.  
 
Esse é o discurso dos demais líderes europeus. Mas será que Vladimir Putin tem planos expansionistas que vão mesmo para além da Ucrânia? Quais as evidências disso? 
 
Ao invadir a Ucrânia, Putin publicou um vídeo em que, logo no início, cita a expansão da Otan e diz que essa é uma questão de vida ou morte para a Rússia. 
 
"Para os EUA e seus aliados, trata-se de uma política de contenção da Rússia, com dividendos geopolíticos evidentes. Para o nosso país, é uma questão de vida ou morte", afirma o presidente russo. 
 
Vamos dar uma olhada na expansão da Otan em 1999 e em 2004. Ela cresceu em países que eram área de influência ou em países que fizeram parte da União Soviética. A Rússia sempre mostrou insatisfação. E traçou uma linha vermelha: Ucrânia e Geórgia não poderiam aderir à aliança.
 
Na Rússia, tem uma doutrina chamada "sobiraniye russkikh zemel", que significa a unificação das terras russas. Num artigo publicado em 2021, Putin cita a ideia ao falar da Rússia medieval. E diz que Rússia, Belarus e Ucrânia são uma nação.  
 
Na história da Rússia, é comum ver figuras históricas sendo lembradas como aqueles que ganharam terras, como Catarina, a Grande, e Pedro, o Grande. E outros como os que perderam terras, como Nicolau 2º e, mais recentemente, Mikhail Gorbachev e Boris Yeltsin.

snippet.title: Siswi SMA Tewas Dianiaya 4 Orang Temannya, Warga Geruduk Rumah Pelaku, Bakar Mobil Polisi
snippet.description:
Tragedi kekerasan yang merenggut nyawa seorang siswi SMA di Kabupaten Malang, Jawa Timur, mengguncang masyarakat. Empat teman korban telah ditetapkan sebagai anak yang berhadapan dengan hukum (ABH) dan menjadi tersangka dalam kasus dugaan penganiayaan yang berujung kematian.

Berdasarkan keterangan kepolisian, peristiwa bermula pada 25 November. Korban dijemput oleh dua orang, kemudian dibawa ke lokasi kejadian dan diduga dianiaya oleh empat orang. Korban sempat dibawa ke rumah salah satu pelaku dalam kondisi tidak sadarkan diri, sebelum akhirnya meninggal dunia saat dalam perjalanan ke rumah sakit. Polisi menyebut dugaan motif penganiayaan dipicu rasa sakit hati terhadap korban.

Kasus ini memicu kemarahan warga. Pada Jumat malam, massa mendatangi perumahan tempat tinggal salah satu terduga pelaku. Aksi tersebut berujung anarkis, dengan perusakan fasilitas perumahan dan pembakaran dua mobil patroli polisi.

Karena keempat tersangka masih berstatus anak, penanganannya dilakukan melalui mekanisme khusus sesuai ketentuan sistem peradilan pidana anak. Gubernur Jawa Timur Khofifah Indar Parawansa turut menyoroti pentingnya peran keluarga, sekolah, dan lingkungan dalam mencegah kekerasan serta perundungan.

Di tengah duka, ibu korban meminta keadilan bagi putrinya agar tragedi serupa tidak kembali terjadi.

#siswisma #penganiayaan #anakberhadapandenganhukum

snippet.title: "Лишилось тільки прізвище": СТРЕЛЬНІКОВ про розрив із ріднею в РФ
snippet.description:
Повну версію інтерв'ю дивіться за посиланням: https://youtu.be/hSuvs2EmN-w

«Мій головний трюк - стати до лав війська». І це говорить актор, який більшість трюків у кіно виконує сам. У першому інтерв’ю після мобілізації Сергій Стрельніков розповів, чому вирішив піти служити, як на це відреагувала дружина і чому ролі військових під час війни викликали в нього докори сумління.

Як в одному тижні його життя могли вміститися Майдан у Києві під час Революції гідності та зйомки в головних ролях у москві? І коли він вирішив відмовитися від цих ролей, високих гонорарів і слави, яку вони приносили?

Ексклюзивна розмова вже на YouTube-каналі «Марічка».

snippet.title: Marvel Is Spoiling Doomsday In Its Own TV Spots
snippet.description:
A new Avengers: Doomsday TV spot dropped on November 26, 2026, and it packs more plot reveals than the final trailer. Marvel is doing what they always do: spoiling their own movie in the marketing. Here is what the new TV spot reveals, Marvel's history of doing this, and why we need a spoiler-free pact before December 17.

The New TV Spot Reveals

Marvel released a 30-second TV spot on November 26, 2026. In 30 seconds, they revealed more plot than any single Doomsday trailer so far.

1. Magneto vs Doctor Doom

Ian McKellen's Magneto faces Doctor Doom (Robert Downey Jr.) in a direct confrontation. Magneto's line: "He is pain. He is extinction."

Magneto uses his magnetism to try and rip Doom's metal mask off. He fails. Green magic holds the mask to Doom's face. For a brief moment, we see the scarred visage of Victor Von Doom underneath, his eyes glowing green.

Doom's response: "I am Doom."

This is the FIRST time Marvel has shown Doom's unmasked face in any promotional material. Months of speculation about whether RDJ looks like Tony Stark under the mask is now partially answered.

2. Shang-Chi Without His Rings

The TV spot shows Simu Liu's Shang-Chi in action without the Ten Rings. This is a major plot point. His rings may have been taken by Doom, destroyed, or given to someone else earlier in the film. Shang-Chi fighting without his signature weapons is a huge hint at his arc.

3. The Incursion That Destroys Tobey Maguire's Universe

The TV spot shows an incursion event that appears to destroy Earth-96283, the home universe of Tobey Maguire's Spider-Man (Sam Raimi trilogy). Two Earths collide.

This suggests Marvel is actively destroying beloved multiverse universes in Doomsday. No one is safe. Not even nostalgia.

4. Doctor Doom Attacks The TVA

The TV spot shows Doom attacking the Time Variance Authority. This confirms the TVA has an active role in Doomsday and Doom's plan involves dismantling the organization that monitors the multiverse.

5. Thor And Steve Rogers Confront Doom

Extended footage shows Thor and Steve Rogers together in Doom's throne room. The confrontation leads to a white and green energy collision.

Marvel's TV Spot Spoiler Problem

This is not a new issue. Marvel has repeatedly spoiled their own movies in TV spots across the last decade.

Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014): TV spots showed the full elevator fight sequence. One of the film's most iconic moments was reduced to a 15-second promo clip.

Captain America: Brave New World (2025): TV spots revealed Red Hulk before audiences could experience the reveal in theaters. The Thunderbolt Ross transformation was marketed openly.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2026): TV spots revealed multiple third-act beats including the Venom tease and the suit upgrade reveal. By the time fans walked into the theater, half the surprises were gone.

The Pattern

Marvel's marketing team optimizes for pre-release engagement. Every TV spot needs a "wow" moment to get fans talking. The easiest "wow" is a plot reveal. So every TV spot leaks a new piece of the story.

By the time the film releases, hardcore fans know 60 percent of the movie before buying a ticket.

What To Expect From Doomsday

Between now and December 17, Marvel will release at least 5 to 10 more TV spots. Each one will reveal more. Expect:

More Magneto vs Doom footage
More incursion shots
Possible Wanda reveal
Possible Reed Richards death tease
Possible Young Avengers formation shots
Possible cameo reveals (Deadpool, Wolverine, surprise returns)

The Spoiler-Free Pact

Here is my commitment to you. I will NOT spoil Doomsday beyond what Marvel has already officially released in trailers and TV spots. No leaked set photos. No test screening reports. No plot details from inside sources.

In return, I ask you to do the same. Do not post leaked footage. Do not share spoilers in comments. Do not ruin Doomsday for anyone.

We have waited 7 years since Endgame for this moment. Let us all experience it together, in theaters, without having the biggest moments pre-spoiled.

How To Stay Spoiler-Free

Mute keywords on social media: "Doomsday spoilers," "Doom unmasked," "incursion," "Doomsday leak."
Avoid Reddit's MCU subreddits until you see the film.
Skip TV spots if you can. Trailers only.
Do not click clickbait thumbnails.
